[Intro]

[Lick1] [ch]C[/ch]    [ch]G/B[/ch]   [ch]Am[/ch]    


[Verse]

[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]           [ch]G/B[/ch]              [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]Am/G[/ch]
I knew a man Bojangles and he'd dance for you [/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]     [Lick1]
  In worn out shoes[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]G/B[/ch]               [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]Am/G[/ch]
With silver hair, a ragged shirt, and baggy pants[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]    [Lick2]
   The old soft shoe [/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]E[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Am/G[/ch]
  He jumped so high,  jumped so high[/tab]
[tab][ch]D/F#[/ch]                        [ch]G[/ch]     [ch]G7[/ch]           [Lick1]
    Then he lightly touched down[/tab]

[tab]  [ch]C[/ch]            [ch]G/B[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]Am/G[/ch] 
I met him in a cell in New Orleans I was [/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]  [Lick1]
  down and out[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]               [ch]G/B[/ch]    [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]Am/G[/ch]
He looked to me to be the eyes of age[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                    [ch]G[/ch]  [Lick2]
   as he spoke right out [/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]  [ch]E[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Am/G[/ch] [ch]D/F#[/ch]
   He talked of life, talked of life,            he laughed[/tab]
[tab]                      [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]G7[/ch]      [Lick1]
clicked his heels and stepped[/tab]
 
[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]              [ch]G/B[/ch]               [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]Am/G[/ch]
He said his name "Bojangles" and he danced a lick [/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]             [ch]G[/ch]    [Lick1]
  across the cell[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]                     [ch]G/B[/ch]                     [ch]Am[/ch]             [ch]Am/G[/ch]
He grabbed his pants and spread his stance,Oh he jumped so high [/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                          [ch]G[/ch]     [Lick2]
   and then he clicked his heels [/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]              [ch]Em[/ch]     [ch]E[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]     [ch]Am/G[/ch]
   He let go a laugh, let go a laugh[/tab]
[tab][ch]D/F#[/ch]                                [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]G7[/ch] 
     and shook back his clothes all around[/tab]


[Chorus]

[tab][ch]Am[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]
   Mr. Bojangles,    Mr. Bojangles[/tab]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]        [ch]C[/ch]     [ch]G/B[/ch]  [ch]Am[/ch] [Lick1]
   Mr. Bojangles, dance[/tab]


[Verse]

[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]                   [ch]G/B[/ch]                [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]Am/G[/ch]
He danced for those at minstrel shows and county fairs[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]    [Lick1]
  throughout the south[/tab]
[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]                      [ch]G/B[/ch]              [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]Am/G[/ch]
He spoke through tears of 15 years how his dog and him[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]           [ch]G[/ch]     [Lick2]
  traveled about[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                [ch]Em[/ch]   [ch]E[/ch]            [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Am/G[/ch]
  The dog up and died,   he up and died[/tab]
[tab][ch]D/F#[/ch]                             [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]G7[/ch] 
     And after 20 years he still grieves [/tab]

[tab]   [ch]C[/ch]                   [ch]G/B[/ch]             [ch]Am[/ch]           [ch]Am/G[/ch]
He said I dance now at every chance in honky tonks[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]    [Lick1]
  for drinks and tips[/tab]
[tab]    [ch]C[/ch]               [ch]G/B[/ch]                [ch]Am[/ch]          [ch]Am/G[/ch]
But most the time I spend behind these county bars[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]                   [ch]G[/ch]     [Lick2]
  'cause I drinks a bit[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]               [ch]Em[/ch]    [ch]E[/ch]                   [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Am/G[/ch]
   He shook his head, and as he shook his head[/tab]
[tab][ch]D/F#[/ch]                        [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]G7[/ch] 
    I heard someone ask him please plee-ease[/tab]


[Chorus]

[tab][ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]        [ch]Am[/ch]         [ch]G[/ch]
    Mr. Bojangles,      Mr. Bojangles[/tab]
[tab][ch]Am[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]          [ch]C[/ch]     [ch]G/B[/ch]    [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Am/G[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch] ......
   Mr. Bojangles,   dance[/tab]
